record.paper_title: Open problems on structure of positively curved projective varieties
record.context_brief: Kähler extension of the ntf inequality
record.original_question: Let X be a compact Kähler manifold with Kähler metric g of semi-positive holomorphic sectional curvature. For p in X, let V_flat,p be the subspace of T_X,p consisting of tangent vectors v such that R_g(v,x,y,z̄)=0 for every x,y,z in T_X,p, and define ntf(X,g)=dim X−inf_p dim V_flat,p. If φ: X ⇢ Y is an MRC fibration in the same rationally connected sense as for projective varieties, does the inequality dim X−dim Y ≥ ntf(X,g), known in the smooth projective case, still hold in the compact Kähler setting?

evidence.quote: The invariant ntf(X, g) can be seen as an analog of the numerical Kodaira dimension (see [43] for the definition) and measures the positivity of holomorphic sectional curvatures.
Let X be a smooth projective variety and g be a Kähler metric with semi-positive holomorphic sectional curvature. Let φ : X ⇢ Y be an MRC fibration of X. Then we obtain dim X − dim Y ⩾ ntf(X, g).
This theorem is expected to still hold in the case where X is a compact Kähler manifold.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X$ be a compact Kähler manifold of complex dimension $n$, equipped with a Kähler metric $g$ whose holomorphic sectional curvature is semi-positive, i.e. $R_g(v,\bar v, v, \bar v) \geq 0$ for every tangent vector $v \in T_{X,p}$ and every point $p \in X$. For each $p \in X$, define the "flat" subspace
$$V_{\mathrm{flat},p} := \{ v \in T_{X,p} : R_g(v,x,y,\bar z) = 0 \text{ for all } x,y,z \in T_{X,p} \},$$
and set
$$\mathrm{ntf}(X,g) := \dim_{\mathbb{C}} X - \inf_{p \in X} \dim_{\mathbb{C}} V_{\mathrm{flat},p}.$$
Let $\varphi : X \dashrightarrow Y$ be a maximal rationally connected (MRC) fibration of $X$, i.e. a dominant meromorphic map to a compact Kähler manifold $Y$ whose general fibers are rationally connected and which is maximal among such fibrations. 

Prove or disprove: under these hypotheses, the inequality
$$\dim X - \dim Y \;\geq\; \mathrm{ntf}(X,g)$$
holds. (The analogous statement when $X$ is a smooth projective variety is known.)
artifact.category_tag: Kähler geometry and holomorphic sectional curvature
artifact.status_search_result: The inequality is established in the smooth projective setting (Matsumura and related work on structure of MRC fibrations under semi-positive holomorphic sectional curvature). Its extension to the general compact Kähler setting is stated as an expectation, and a web search did not reveal a published proof; the problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Matsumura - On projective manifolds with semi-positive holomorphic sectional curvature
status_evidence.snippet: Matsumura established a structure theorem for projective manifolds with nonnegative holomorphic sectional curvature by studying the structure of MRC fibration.
status_evidence.claim: The projective version of the inequality has been established, but the Kähler extension is not cited as proved.

status_evidence.title: Kähler manifolds and holomorphic sectional curvature - related literature
status_evidence.snippet: Recent works study Kähler metrics of (semi-)negative holomorphic (bi)sectional curvature on relative Kähler fibrations.
status_evidence.claim: No evidence found of a proof of the ntf-inequality in the compact Kähler case.
